title: Diagnostics Perf Profiling Infra v1
problem: Make Fret performance profiling surfaces review-grade by keeping frame stats, phase timelines, CPU-vs-wall signals, trace artifacts, and perf key contracts explainable, additive, and tied to reproducible evidence.

repro.summary: Start from a perf bundle, compare wall time with CPU signals, then inspect stats or a synthetic Chrome trace before deciding whether external Tracy/ETW/RenderDoc is needed.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag stats <bundle.json> --sort time --top 30
cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag stats <bundle.json> --sort cpu_cycles --top 30

gates.name: perf-key-registry-tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-diag trace_exported_perf_keys_are_unique registered_perf_keys_are_unique trace_exported_perf_key_units_match_names registered_perf_key_units_match_names registered_perf_key_contract_keeps_stats_and_gate_keys_additive trace_exported_perf_key_registry_contains_core_timeline_keys chrome_trace_includes_trace_events stats_json_includes_avg_and_budget --no-fail-fast

gates.name: example-bundle-stats-json
gates.command: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag stats docs/workstreams/diag-perf-profiling-infra-v1/examples/perf-profiling-mini --sort time --top 5 --json

continue_policy.notes: Continue here for perf profiling infrastructure, phase coverage, CPU-vs-wall attribution, and perf key registry work. Split a narrower follow-on for automated real-span capture/export if it needs runtime-wide tracing subscriber changes.
